title: AI LinkedIn post writer in your voice, $19/month

source.text: An AI tool that writes LinkedIn posts in your voice, $19 a month. Launch country US, budget $1,000, 10 hours a week, goal side income, edge: I am a developer. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug linkedin-ai-writer.

problem: Writing LinkedIn posts that sound like you takes time; generic AI output sounds like AI.
solution: An AI tool that writes LinkedIn posts in the user's own voice.
claims: An AI tool that writes LinkedIn posts in your voice
assumptions: Customer assumed: US consultants, solo founders and B2B professionals who post on LinkedIn weekly.
Channel assumed: none in hand (no audience stated); paid search or LinkedIn Ads plus organic launches.
Voice is learned from posts the user pastes or exports, not by scraping LinkedIn.
Stripe US card fee assumed at 2.9% + $0.30 (the page served was the EUR version).
Headless run: no questions asked; follow-up facts (audience size, validation) assumed to be zero.
